root_cause_of_prior_block.prior_belief: Obsidian was blocked because obsidian_rest_token was an empty 0-byte secret and no vault was configured.
root_cause_of_prior_block.actual: The destination prefers a filesystem vault and falls back to the Local REST API only when no vault root is set. The REST token was never required. The earlier check also read SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_OBSIDIAN_VAULT, which is not the variable the product reads; the real name is SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_OBSIDIAN_VAULT_ROOT.
root_cause_of_prior_block.fix: Set SOCIAL_ARCHIVE_OBSIDIAN_VAULT_ROOT=/var/lib/social-archive/obsidian-vault, inside the existing bind-mounted data plane so the vault persists on the host and the Owner can open or sync it directly. Directory created 10001:10001 mode 2770. Prior .env preserved at /opt/social-archive-rollback/env-before-obsidian-vault.bak.

incidental_finding.what: POST /v1/library/{id}/export takes destination_ids. A request sent with a `destinations` key is accepted with HTTP 202 and silently exports nothing, returning empty destination_ids, skipped_destination_ids and job_ids.
incidental_finding.impact: A caller using the wrong field name cannot tell success from a silent no-op, because the skipped list stays empty too.

what_this_does_not_prove: SA-403 closure. The frozen Oracle also covers the standard Markdown and JSONL destinations, which were not exercised in this run.
SA-402. Notion remains unconfigured and is not addressed here.
Any account-level mirror. The exported item is the canary content row.
non_actions: No Obsidian REST token, Notion token, or any other secret was created, read, or written.
No user content other than the canary row was exported in this run.
No timer, tag, release, or push occurred.

standard_markdown_and_jsonl_export.verdict: PASS — the standard Markdown and JSONL halves of SA-403 both produce real, well-formed output on production.

incidental_finding_notion_csv.why_it_matters: It gives a zero-credential path to get the library into Notion by manual CSV import. It is not the SA-402 API destination and does not substitute for it, but it means the Owner is not entirely without a Notion route while the Integration token is missing.
